verdict.rationale: Docs give explicit one-liner install commands — `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` via Claude Code's official marketplace, and `npx skills update`/install flow, plus an aihero.dev quick-start ('Install the ones you want, then type a slash command') — covering CLI, marketplace, and package-manager routes. Missing for 10: no explicit confirmation that skills are live in the very next session without extra steps, and no independent/hands-on report verifying the install-then-use flow works as documented.
